notes.title: 🔧Update 1.0.4.2 — Skippable Intro, Volume Tweak & Achievement Logic Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update brings a few quality-of-life improvements and small but meaningful fixes — once again thanks to the helpful feedback from Prof.Vaharrak. I'm really grateful for the support and suggestions!

✅ Changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] The intro is now skippable.

[*] The intro volume has been reduced from 1.0 to 0.5 for a smoother experience.

[*] All Click Power and Click Per Second achievements now use the final calculated values instead of raw base values. This makes them more accurate and fair for progression.
[/list]

Thank you again to Prof.Vaharrak, and to all of you who continue to support the game!

notes.title: 🐛 Hotfix 1.0.4.1 — Infinite Value Upgrade Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is a small hotfix to address a bug that caused upgrade values to reach infinity after around 600 purchases.

✅ Bug fix:

Thanks to user Prof.Vaharrak, we discovered that the upgrade multiplier was using a float type, which has a maximum value of 3.402823466e+38. This was causing calculations to overflow and return Infinity.

The multiplier calculation now uses double, which supports values up to 1.79769E+308.

Additionally, a safety cap has been added to prevent values from exceeding 1.79769E+308, ensuring they never become infinite again.

Thank you again to Prof.Vaharrak for the report.

notes.title: 🏆 Update 1.0.4 — Achievement System Refactor + Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve released update 1.0.4 with important fixes and improvements:

✅ Achievement system:

The entire achievement system has been refactored. All known issues with achievements have been resolved.

If you have achievements unlocked in-game but not on Steam, they will now sync and unlock automatically when you start the game.

Fixed the Ascension Points 6 achievement, which previously had an incorrect ID and couldn’t be obtained.

✅ Other improvements:

Small performance improvement across the game.

Thank you for your patience and support! Sorry for the bugs — the game’s code is quite old, from back when I was still learning how to program.

notes.title: ⚖️ Balance Update 1.0.3 — Upgrade Cost and Achievement Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve released a small balance update to make progress smoother and achievements more achievable:

Balance changes:

-Adjusted click upgrade cost coefficient from 4 to 2.5.

-Adjusted llamas per second upgrade cost coefficient from 2 to 1.4.

Achievement adjustments:

-Level achievements are now easier to obtain.

-Click power achievements are now easier to obtain.

-Llamas per second power achievements are now easier to obtain.

-Llamas power achievements are now easier to obtain.

-Total llamas spent achievements are now easier to obtain.

-Ascension points achievements are now easier to obtain.

-Thank you for playing and for all your feedback

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 1.0.2 — Removal of Bugged Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve released another small hotfix with the following change:

✅ Changes:

Removed the achievements "Times Ascended 1 through Times Ascended 9". These achievements had a bug that prevented players from unlocking them, and since I wasn’t able to fix the issue at this time, I’ve decided to remove them for now.

I apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 1.0.1 — Volume Control Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve released a small hotfix to address an issue with the audio system:

✅ Fixes:

Fixed a bug that prevented the volume from being fully muted in the sound settings.

I apologize for the delay — I’m currently dealing with some personal matters and have been a bit short on time.

Thank you for your feedback and support!
